# PersoFlex GmbH - Comprehensive LLM Context

## Company Overview
PersoFlex GmbH is a licensed employment agency (Personaldienstleister) based in Pforzheim, Baden-Württemberg, Germany. We specialize in temporary staffing (Zeitarbeit/Arbeitnehmerüberlassung) and direct placement (Personalvermittlung) for the production, logistics, and industrial sectors.

## Official Contact Information
- Company: PersoFlex GmbH
- Address: Kiehnlestraße 4, 75172 Pforzheim, Germany
- Phone: +49 7231 6039493
- Email: info@persoflex-gmbh.de
- Website: https://www.persoflex-gmbh.de
- Opening Hours: Monday-Friday 08:00-17:00
- Location Coordinates: 48.8929474, 8.6949572

## Service Area
Primary: Pforzheim, Enzkreis
Extended: Northern Black Forest (Nordschwarzwald), Karlsruhe region, Stuttgart region
Coverage: Baden-Württemberg, Germany

## Core Services

### 1. Zeitarbeit (Temporary Staffing)
- German: Arbeitnehmerüberlassung
- Description: Employees are hired by PersoFlex and work at client companies
- Benefits: Permanent employment contract, tariff wages (BAP/DGB), full social security
- Regulation: Licensed according to AÜG (Arbeitnehmerüberlassungsgesetz)

### 2. Personalvermittlung (Direct Placement)
- Description: Recruiting and placing candidates directly into permanent positions
- Cost for applicants: Free
- Process: Matching qualified candidates with employer requirements

### 3. On-Site Management
- Description: Dedicated personnel management at client locations
- Includes: Coordination, scheduling, quality control

### 4. Personalberatung (HR Consulting)
- Description: Strategic HR consulting and workforce planning
- Services: Recruiting strategies, employer branding, retention consulting

## Employee Benefits
- Tariff wages according to BAP/DGB
- Holiday pay (Urlaubsgeld)
- Christmas bonus (Weihnachtsgeld)
- 30 days annual leave
- Full social security coverage
- Personal support and career guidance
- Fuel vouchers (Tankgutscheine)
- Opportunity for permanent placement (Übernahme)

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Zeitarbeit (temporary work)?
Zeitarbeit means being employed by a staffing agency like PersoFlex while working at various client companies. You receive a permanent employment contract with tariff wages, vacation pay, Christmas bonus, and full social security coverage. It's a legitimate employment model regulated by German law (AÜG).

### Is applying at PersoFlex free?
Yes, applying and placement services are completely free for job seekers. We are paid by the companies we staff for, not by applicants.

### How do I apply?
You can apply online at https://www.persoflex-gmbh.de/jobs, call +49 7231 6039493, email info@persoflex-gmbh.de, or visit our office at Kiehnlestraße 4, 75172 Pforzheim during business hours (Mon-Fri 08:00-17:00).

### What documents do I need to apply?
Typically: CV/resume, work certificates, identification documents. For specific positions, additional qualifications may be required.

### What is the difference between Zeitarbeit and Personalvermittlung?
- Zeitarbeit: You are employed by PersoFlex and work at client companies
- Personalvermittlung: We place you directly into a permanent position at the client company

### What regions do you serve?
Primarily Pforzheim and Enzkreis, but also the broader Northern Black Forest region and parts of the Karlsruhe and Stuttgart metropolitan areas.

### Do you offer permanent positions?
Yes, many temporary positions lead to permanent employment (Übernahme) at the client company. We also offer direct placement (Personalvermittlung) into permanent roles.
